definitions.explanation: A word chosen to represent the content of a document so that it can be found in an index or search. Used in publishing, libraries, and information retrieval.

examples.japanese: {索引語|さくいんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{索引語|さくいんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Attach index terms to a paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な{索引語|さくいんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧しやすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Assigning appropriate index terms makes documents easier to search.

notes:
Combines ⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧ (index) with ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word, term). A term used to index or retrieve a document, in publishing and information science.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {索引語|さくいんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to assign index terms
- {索引語|さくいんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選定|せんてい}→選定：14452_sentei⟧: selection of index terms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キーワード→キーワード：10832_kiiwaado⟧: keyword — the everyday, broader term
- ⟦{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}→見出し語：24989_midashigo⟧: headword — the word that heads a dictionary or index entry
